name: Pininfarina
verdict: Controlled by PF Holdings B.V. (78.82%), the Mahindra group consortium vehicle; state-owned Life Insurance Corporation of India holds 11.49% of consortium member Tech Mahindra. On hold for a maintainer.
note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer, changed from none during review of PR #1227. A Tech Mahindra/Mahindra & Mahindra consortium agreed to buy 76.06% of Pininfarina S.p.A. in 2015 and Pininfarina's own site says it is 'part of the Mahindra galaxy since 2016'; its 2024 corporate-governance report (ownership structure as of 31 December 2024) says it is 'controlled by PF Holdings B.V., which holds 78.82% of the Company's share capital'. LIC, whose promoter is the President of India (96.50%), holds 11.49% of Tech Mahindra (quarter ended 31 December 2025); multiplied along the PF Holdings chain that indirect state stake may pass METHOD.md's 5% mark, and whether it counts depends on how India is treated as a state record — a maintainer decision. No human-rights finding against the company itself was identified.
